📖 Explanation:

While main team Red Bull Racing ran Renault power units in 2008, sister team Scuderia Toro Rosso used customer Ferrari 056 2.4-litre V8 engines in their STR3 chassis.

Vettel's triumph at Monza made Toro Rosso a Grand Prix-winning team with Ferrari power before Red Bull Racing had even secured its first F1 victory.
